verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a query-suggestions feature, a suggestions index, or an autocomplete library or widget. Search analytics on popular searches (algolia-docs-9) and InstantSearch UI widgets (algolia-docs-8) are related but different capabilities. Neither shows suggestions built from real search traffic and served as autocomplete, so this applicable axis is unevidenced.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve query suggestions and autocomplete backed by real search traffic or a suggestions index
